ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; pixel distribution is approximately 98% low-intensity (black) with 2% high-intensity (white) pixels localized to surface abrasions and marginal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform solid black pigmentation across the entire visible ventral surface. Discrete, high-contrast white pixel clusters are mapped at the distal tips of both lobes. Sparse, multi-pixel width linear white tracks are distributed across the mid-lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a pixel convergence angle of approximately 80 degrees; vertical bounding-box depth is roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (3-10 pixel peak-to-valley height) along the continuous trailing edge boundary; serration is most prominent on the medial half of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature fitted to the trailing edges of both lobes, with a smooth, continuous sweep tapering to sharp distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small clusters of high-intensity (white) pixels localized at the extreme distal tips and irregularly along the trailing margins, consistent with focal scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple discrete, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (1-3 pixels wide) cutting across the black pigmentation, primarily oriented diagonally on both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Detection of multiple white linear rake marks across the ventral surfaces and punctate scarring at the distal extremities.
